title: ERC-8126: AI Agent Verification
quote: This standard establishes protocols for verifying AI agents registered through ERC-8004 using five specialized verification mechanisms: Ethereum Token Verification (ETV), Media Content Verification (MCV), Solidity Code Verification (SCV), Web Application Verification (WAV), and Wallet Verification (WV). Verification providers generate Zero-Knowledge Proofs via Private Data Verification (PDV), producing unified risk scores (0-100) accessible only to wallet holders.

title: ERC-8126 source (ethereum/ERCs repository)
quote: status: "Final" ... requires: "155, 191, 712, 721, 3009, 8004". Overall risk score is the arithmetic mean of applicable verification scores.

title: ERC-8126: AI Agent (Registration and) Verification — discussion
quote: @opwizardx: 'If ERC-8126 gains traction as a standalone standard, we end up with ... consumers needing to check both systems.' @lejuho flagged that WAV verification only confirms endpoint reachability but 'doesn't verify what code is actually executing behind that endpoint.' The proposal achieved Draft status on February 10, 2026, and entered Last Call by late May ... Cybercentry deferred carrier-format standardization to post-Final erratum rather than reopening Last Call.

title: ERC-8004: Trustless Agents
quote: Status: Draft. Created 2025-08-13. Requires EIP-155, EIP-712, EIP-721, EIP-1271. Defines Identity, Reputation, and Validation registries; Identity is built on ERC-721 with URI storage.

title: ERC-8126 | AI Agent Registration and Verification (project site)
quote: A final Ethereum standard for AI agent verification. Authored by Cronian L (@cybercentry) and Johnson C (@virtuals_io). 'A MORE SECURE ETHEREUM' / 'SPECIALIZED MULTI-LAYER VERIFICATION'.

title: ERC-8004: A Developer's Guide to Trustless AI Agent Identity
quote: The validation registry 'isn't finished yet' and is described as 'a design space' rather than shipped infrastructure. The guide does not mention ERC-8126 or external verification providers.

title: x402 & ERC-8004: How AI Agents Pay on the Agentic Web
quote: ERC-8004 answers 'who you are' and 'how trustworthy you are' through on-chain identity and reputation, while x402 handles 'how agents pay each other' via HTTP-native micropayments. x402 is built on EIP-3009 (transferWithAuthorization).

title: Towards Multi-Agent Economies: Enhancing the A2A Protocol with Ledger-Anchored Identities and x402 Micropayments for AI Agents
quote: Enhancing the A2A protocol with ledger-anchored identities and x402 micropayments for AI agents — framing identity, trust, and payment as the core primitives of an emerging multi-agent economy.

title: ERC-8196 | AI Agent Authenticated Wallet (project site)
quote: ERC-8196 is the execution layer of a three-tier trust framework — registration (ERC-8004), verification (ERC-8126), execution (ERC-8196). Authored by Cronian L (@cybercentry) and Johnson C (@virtuals_io); wallets execute transactions only when accompanied by verifiable cryptographic proof of policy compliance.

title: What is ERC-8004? The Ethereum Standard Enabling Trustless AI Agents
quote: ERC-8004 establishes three lightweight on-chain registries (Identity, Reputation, Validation); it takes inspiration from Google's A2A protocol and was launched on Ethereum mainnet in January 2026.

title: ERC-8004 and the Ethereum AI Agent Economy: Technical, Economic, and Policy Analysis
quote: Independent technical/economic/policy analysis of the ERC-8004 agent economy — used here as context for the identity layer beneath ERC-8126.
